message: リ・クリエに向けて
Azel hasn't been in the classroom since this morning.
It's supposed to be a familiar sight, yet my mood feels unusually heavy.

name: Synn
message: 「……Yeah, of course he wouldn't show up」
After everything, I really thought of Azel as a friend…….

name: Synn
message: 「Sigh……」

name: Macaron
message: 「What's wrong, Big Brother? You're looking down」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yeah……」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm just a little worried about Azel」

name: Macaron
message: 「Oh…… right」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm worried about Azel-san too……」

name: Macaron
message: 「But moping around won't get us anywhere!」

name: Macaron
message: 「We have to do our best at what we can do」

name: Macaron
message: 「So that we can come to understand each other with Azel-san, too」

name: Macaron
message: 「So come on, cheer up?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah……」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shiiin, what's our next class again?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Oh, uhhh……」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nana-oneechan, next is English!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Uwaaah~, I forgot to do the prep work!」

name: Synn
message: 「Same as ever, huh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shut up!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「More importantly--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Macaron-chan's totally fitted right in, hasn't she~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now that you mention it」

name: Synn
message: 「Getting used to things is scary, isn't it」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Coming from you, Synn-kun, that just sounds like bragging about your love life--」

name: Synn
message: 「No way, not at all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't say that, Sacchin! That's already over and done with!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hey, Big Brother, I'm gonna sit next to you, so scoot over a bit」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Oh, sure……」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ta-da, seated!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're pretty close」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nihehe-- don't be so picky!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm going out of my way to try and cheer you up, after all!」

name: Synn
message: 「Do I really look that down?」

name: Macaron
message: 「What, are you saying I'm worrying too much too?」

name: Synn
message: 「I wouldn't say that, but……」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nihehe……」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm right here by your side, Big Brother」

name: Macaron
message: 「We'll worry together and keep pushing forward together」

name: Macaron
message: 「So, it'll be okay!」

name: Synn
message: 「……Somehow, hearing you say it so seriously makes me embarrassed」

name: Macaron
message: 「That's only because you say stuff like that!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha, maybe so」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Grrr! Flirting right out in public like that!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan--……」

name: Synn
message: 「By the way, where'd you get that chair?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Tennouji-san lent it to me」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, are you sure?」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「Don't worry about it. I'll go take classes in the next classroom」

name: Macaron
message: 「Thanks a bunch!」

name: Synn
message: 「If you were gonna take someone's seat, you should've just taken Eddie's chair」

name: Eddie
message: 「Hey, hold on a second, that's messed up!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Isn't it better than having fewer girls around~?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah……」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmph……」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, no, that's not it at all!　Definitely not!」

name: Eddie
message: 「Your voice just cracked……」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big brother……」

name: Synn
message: 「As long as I have Macaron with me, that's more than enough for me!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't yell that out loud, it's embarrassing just watching you!」

name: Synn
message: 「Bwah!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ahaha~, tough luck~」

name: Synn
message: 「What's with everyone ganging up on me……」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well then, how about I knock some spirit into you」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha!?　Doing that in the classroom is bad!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Oh, right」

name: Macaron
message: 「Then I'll go with a karate chop!」

name: Synn
message: 「Make it an open palm, please!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hiyah!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ouch」

name: Macaron
message: 「Take that! Don't say anything inappropriate anymore, okay!」

name: Synn
message: 「...Macaron, your hands are cold」

name: Macaron
message: 「Huh? You think so...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Let me see them」
I take Macaron's hands, wrap them in my palms, and give them a gentle squeeze.

name: Synn
message: 「Just bear with it for a bit」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Ehehe」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Your hands are warm, Big Brother」

name: Synn
message: 「...Macaron」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks for cheering me up」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm okay now, so」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's work together and save Azel」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Yeah!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nihihi... squeeze」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, that hurts, Macaron」

name: Macaron
message: 「Squeeeze」

name: Synn
message: 「Geez...」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh, what? Do you all want a turn too?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You two, really...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Huh? Is it just me, or is it kinda noisy outside the classroom...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ba-dump... Holding hands like that, whatever are they planning to do...」

name: Shio
message: 「T-To do such things in this sacred academy... How indecent!」

name: Misa
message: 「I sensed an alluring atmosphere and came to peek, and... aah, I want to do that with Onee-sama too...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Heehee... Truly, it's quite heartwarming, isn't it」

name: Ria
message: 「M-Maybe it's okay if we watch just a little bit longer...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We've got a whole gallery forming!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Brother. Looks like we're pretty popular, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, I guess...」

name: Synn
message: 「Want to share my textbook?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah!」

name: Synn
message: 「You take notes like this」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmm, I see...」

name: Synn
message: 「And then, this part here...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nnh, geez... Big Brother, you're too close...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, sorry, sorry」

name: Macaron
message: 「I don't really mind, though...\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「Ow」

name: Macaron
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nah, it's nothing...」
On the edge of the desk, there's an eraser shaving I don't recognize.

name: Synn
message: 「Who's flicking stuff like this...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ouch」
Next, a crumpled-up scrap of notebook paper comes flying over.

name: Synn
message: 「What's going...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ow-ow-ow」
A-An actual eraser!?
Aah, mechanical pencils, textbooks, a recorder, and even someone's shoe and bag!

name: Synn
message: 「Ouch, ouch!」
Before I know it, I'm hogging the entire class's attention!

name: Macaron
message: 「You really are popular, Big Brother.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It seems so...」
For some reason, I was the only one made to stand in the hallway afterward.
Well, Macaron took notes for me instead, so I guess it's fine.

name: Synn
message: 「Excuse me~」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, welcome. Are the preparations for the Holy Night Festival going smoothly?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yes. Everything's going without a hitch so far.」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm really looking forward to seeing how it turns out this year.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Leave it to us! We'll definitely make it something wonderful!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm helping out too, you know!」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu, how reliable~」

name: Melilot
message: 「Helena, talking about the Holy Night Festival is all well and good, but...」

name: Ria
message: 「This was supposed to be a Crusaders strategy meeting, right?」

name: Helena
message: 「I know, I know~」

name: Helena
message: 「But don't you think times like these are precisely when we should lift our spirits with fun talk?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please take your time doing that after we're finished.」

name: Helena
message: 「Boo, boo! I'm gonna grope your tits!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Why would you do that?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah! If you're gonna grope, it's gotta be Ria-chan's tits, obviously!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Jumper!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Good grief...」

name: Misa
message: 「I can never tell if they're being serious or just fooling around...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Perhaps that is what they call adult composure.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmm, I see...」

name: Ria
message: 「I really don't think that's it...\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, so, what's the main topic...?」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, how naughty of me. I was so entranced by Melilot's charms that I nearly lost myself.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Shall we ignore Helena and move on with the discussion?」

name: Helena
message: 「Jeez, you're such a shy one.」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Ahem. First of all, thank you for your hard work repelling Soltia the other day.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Though we barely did anything.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Not just 'barely'--we did nothing at all.」

name: Misa
message: 「So, Professor Sengen'in... why was Soltia at this academy?」

name: Melilot
message: 「From what I've investigated, setting up a magic circle to stabilize Re-Crea...」

name: Melilot
message: 「And concealing Azel-san's power appear to have been her objectives.」

name: Synn
message: 「Stabilize?」

name: Melilot
message: 「The power of Re-Crea is immense. It's entirely possible that it could prove too much for Azel-san to handle.」

name: Melilot
message: 「The magic circle was meant to assist in controlling that power and prevent it from running rampant.」

name: Synn
message: 「And the fact that she went out of her way to set that location inside the academy means...」

name: Ria
message: 「Finis Tower...」

name: Helena
message: 「Bingo. Finis Tower is, so to speak, the boundary between the Human World, Heaven, and the Demon World...」

name: Helena
message: 「It's the place that can most easily influence the three realms, while also being the most prone to instability.」

name: Melilot
message: 「The efficient and certain fulfillment of Re-Crea...」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is why they chose this place.」

name: Paqy
message: 「So infiltrating the academy to keep tabs on Aze-bro was killing two birds with one stone, huh.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Can't we just smash that magic circle or something?」

name: Helena
message: 「Unfortunately, that's impossible as things stand now.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Soltia may have been the one who devised the plan, but the magic circle itself was woven using the script of angels...」

name: Melilot
message: 「In other words, it was made by Azel-san.」

name: Synn
message: 「What does that...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「An angel's charm can only be deciphered by someone of higher rank than the angel who wrote it, you see.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Unfortunately, Lady Azel is far, faaar more capable than Amyrina or myself, so...」

name: Misa
message: 「So with the people we have right now, undoing it is impossible...」

name: Melilot
message: 「In the end, does that mean those two didn't trust each other...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then there's nothing left to do except have Lulo-chan get a promotion right now!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Don't be so unreasonable!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Either way... if it's Azel, he'll activate Re-Crea even without a magic circle」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. That's the kind of vibe those eyes had back then」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. There's almost no doubt about it.」

name: Helena
message: 「Then we should actually leave the magic circle as it is」

name: Helena
message: 「After all, we'll be able to handle it safely, which is much better than letting it go berserk for nothing」

name: Synn
message: 「So, the only solution left to us is... ?」

name: Macaron
message: 「A head-on fight?」

name: Helena
message: 「Yahoo! Going toe-to-toe with Azel-chan♪」

name: Melilot
message: 「Well, there is likely no path left other than smashing through them from the front」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-You make it sound so easy, but...」

name: Misa
message: 「I wonder if we can really win...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Everyone, we mustn't lose heart!」

name: Ria
message: 「That's right. After all, we have our wonderful Demon Lord on our side」

name: Ria
message: 「If we all combine our strength, I'm sure we'll be fine\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh! Somehow, I'm suddenly feeling like I can totally do this...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Brother really is so simple...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, does that mean we're heading out on an adventure to search for Azel now?」

name: Helena
message: 「Now, now. Times like this are exactly when you mustn't rush things.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Azel-san will activate Re-Crea when the wave of power reaches its peak......」

name: Melilot
message: 「Based on our observation data so far, that cycle will undoubtedly come around late at night on December 24th.」

name: Helena
message: 「In other words, the very day of the Holy Night Festival will be the day of the Crusaders' decisive battle!」

name: Synn
message: 「The Holy Night Festival......」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then, should we just sit around twiddling our thumbs until then?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I would not recommend wasting our precious time.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Alright! How about we spend every day staring at Ria-chan's bouncing tits?」

name: Helena
message: 「Hop, skip, jump!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Swat!」

name: Macaron
message: 「In that case, why don't we all train together?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Since we actually have the time, we should all get stronger together!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh, that's a great idea!」

name: Helena
message: 「Love that passion! Count me in!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, it does sound more interesting than just waiting around」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hyeuuu~~... I'm gonna pass out from exhaustion before Re-Crea even gets here...」

name: Misa
message: 「We're doing this to protect the world, so take it seriously」

name: Ria
message: 「Then we're all going to have mock battles starting now, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, starting right now?」

name: Macaron
message: 「There's no time like the present, Big Brother!」

name: Synn
message: 「Fair enough」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, let's all do some special training!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yeah!」

name: Melilot
message: 「...It seems there was no need for me to go out of my way to chime in.」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh, Sir Synn, Elder Sister!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, why is Shio-chan here?」

name: Misa
message: 「I called her over. When it comes to special training, there's no reason not to get Shio's help, right?」

name: Shio
message: 「Humble though my abilities may be, I shall lend you my aid!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. That spirit of yours is super reassuring.」
Shio-chan joined the party!

name: Sally
message: 「Ah, found Prez and the others!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Even Sally-chan? What's going on?」

name: Sally
message: 「Someone called me over saying there'd be yummy sweets, so I popped right out, but...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Who called her...」

name: Helena
message: 「Mfufu... Things are getting interesting...」

name: Helena
message: 「Of course, I'll be participating too!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then let's have Jeeves help out as well.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please leave assisting the young lady with her training to me, Riesling Toyama」

name: Riesling
message: 「I have prepared a Marine-style Spartan intensive course that can be mastered in three days.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!」
Riesling-san joined the party!

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-I'll pass on anything too grueling!」

name: Melilot
message: 「How about we divide the teams into the Demon Lord's team and everyone else」

name: Melilot
message: 「Incidentally, I will also be joining the Demon Lord's team.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's pretty pushy...」
Melilot-san joined the party!

name: Macaron
message: 「Sounds fun, though!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Naturally, the great me is on this side too」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright! Let's take Synn down a peg or two since he's getting so full of himself!」

name: Misa
message: 「Yeah, let's show him what we're made of!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Everyone is certainly fired up, aren't they?」

name: Ria
message: 「Well then, shall we get started right away?」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's go, Macaron!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah, bring it on!」
